scope: PHX-ANDROID only; not ecosystem-wide canonical roadmap
stage_gate_policy: A stage is complete only when all mandatory applicable criteria of the stage have exact evidence. Later-stage tests do not close earlier gates.
original_mission: 02_BLAZERENTAL_ANDROID.txt (recovered, read; private file IDs not published)
scope_reconciliation_disclaimer: The 31 criteria are initial workstream decomposition, not a finalized ecosystem-wide denominator. PHX-MASTER owns consolidation, deduplication, and cross-agent weighting.
weight_policy: Fixed risk-weighted points assigned at ledger R1 before measuring acceptance: implementation 32, functional 19, integration 15, QA/security 15, release 10, deployment 7, actual deployment 2. Do not change weights to improve completion.
